scope: Read-only local gradient/counterfactual probe; no training, evaluation endpoint, or queue mutation.

setup.selected_sample_rule: median raw-KL versus standardized-reference feature-gradient cosine

formula.reference: KL between per-sample standardized student and teacher logits

limitations: The standardized-logit gradient is a diagnostic reference, not semantic ground truth.
This is one completed pair/seed and a 128-image fixed probe; it is not an accuracy or causal generalization result.
Virtual updates are local gradients, not a substitute for full-training trajectory evidence.
The student is linear-head KD; this figure does not measure ACI/SICD end-to-end behavior.
